subtheme: Building and rendering 3D worlds from images

subsubthemes.name: Ultra-fast 3D worlds from camera images
subsubthemes.gist: Creating detailed 3D scenes from photos in seconds rather than hours, using splatting techniques to avoid slow geometry solving.

subsubthemes.name: Recreating light and material in 3D scenes
subsubthemes.gist: Figuring out not just the shape but also the reflective surfaces, lighting, and material properties that make a scene look realistic under new conditions.

subsubthemes.name: Showing new camera viewpoints that feel real
subsubthemes.gist: Rendering convincing images from viewpoints never filmed before, while keeping consistency with what was actually filmed.

subsubthemes.name: Handling moving objects and deformation
subsubthemes.gist: Capturing and rendering 3D scenes where people, clothes, cloth, and objects bend and move over time, not just static frozen moments.

subsubthemes.name: Editing and controlling 3D scene appearance
subsubthemes.gist: Letting users change colors, materials, composition, or style of reconstructed 3D worlds after capture without rebuilding from scratch.

subsubthemes.name: Rebuilding special scenes and detailed structures
subsubthemes.gist: Handling difficult real-world captures like underwater scenes, medical imaging, transparent objects, or complex technical geometry that standard methods struggle with.
